interface.longDescription:
ArcanoLabs is a writing and publishing workspace, and this plugin is how an ArcanoLabs account is operated from inside ChatGPT. Its purpose is to carry a piece of writing from idea to published page: plan and draft an article or a book chapter, keep a long manuscript internally consistent as it grows, attach images to it from an existing library, check what readers are actually searching for, and send the finished piece to a WordPress site — without leaving the conversation. In practice it replaces switching between a manuscript editor, an image library, a keyword tool, a contact list and a WordPress admin screen, and it acts only on the data in the account that signed in.

Books, in Scrybe. List a library, read a book's Story Bible and chapter structure, create and arrange chapters, work with fragments and templates, and keep characters, places and story entities consistent as a manuscript grows. Scrybe was previously called StoryForge; some tool names still carry the older "story" spelling for backward compatibility.

Articles and publishing. Plan and draft blog posts, score a draft before it goes out, list unpublished work, reuse or create images from an existing library, and publish or schedule posts to a connected WordPress site.

Search and contacts. SEO tools surface underserved searches and watch rankings for domains the account owns. CRM tools read and update the account's own contacts, companies, deals and pipelines.

Who it is for: writers, solo founders and small teams who already keep their work in ArcanoLabs.

Requirements and limits. An ArcanoLabs account is required; sign-in happens through ArcanoLabs and the tools only ever reach that account's own data. Generation tools draw on the account's credit balance, which is held and managed entirely inside ArcanoLabs. Publishing to WordPress, scheduling a run of posts, and deletes with no restore path always ask before they run. ArcanoLabs cannot receive file uploads through ChatGPT: to attach an image it returns a short-lived upload link to open in a browser.
